Hondruas declared its independence from Spain in 1821, declared its independence from the First Mexican Empire in 1823, and declared its independence from the Federal Republic of Central America in 1838.

Cuba's independence from Spain led directly to an occupation by the United States. (The 1898 Treaty of Paris at the end of the Spahish-American War awarded Cuba to the US). Cuba gained its independence from the USA in 1902.

Nicaragua declared its independence from Spain in 1821, declared its independence from the First Mexican Empire in 1823, declared its independence from the Federal Republic of Central America in 1838, and was internationally recognized as Nicaragua in 1850.

El Salvador declared its independence from Spain in 1821, declared its independence from the First Mexican Empire in 1823, declared its independence from the Federal Republic of Central America in 1824, and was internationally recognized as El Salvador in 1841.

Costa Rica declared its independence from Spain in 1821, declared its independence from the First Mexican Empire in 1823, declared its independence from the Federal Republic of Central America in 1838, and was internationally recognized as Costa Rica in 1850.
Uruguay gained independence from Spain, was annexed by the Empire of Brazil, then regained independence in 1825.
